of families from the entire world and in

The conflicts assailing the world are as
we know the enemy of the well-being to
which we are all entitled.
In the words of our Ruben Dario, we are
in favor of peace. peace peace to make
headway on the goals laid out and in
particular by this organization which
gathers us together. We need to defeat
extreme poverty
and we also need to achieve well-being
for all to bring about a better world
which is so urgent a task.
The scourges of our time are the
greatest threat and greatest danger to
our societies because they deprive us of
our heritage. And we see major crimes
linked to drug trafficking and organized
crime which are forms of terrorism which
assail us and make us sick.
Against this intimidating backdrop, our
purpose, our vote, our commitment has
been and remains clear and we aspire to
gather with more peoples around the
urgent need to curb these afflictions
and to bring about safety and to provide
education, food, health, peace and
development for all.
We would like warmly to greet all
delegations who are present here and we
hope that you will join our commitment
to address these challenges
and to
alleviate the suffering that we have
mentioned.
There are many proposals that we have
mentioned and we wish to stress the
strength that
the
BRICS countries for instance have shown
in striving for better living conditions
for their people and the right of all to
achieve sustainable development in a
complimentary way.
We would like to recognize and pay
tribute to all brothers and sisters
throughout the world who believe in
ideals, principles and values that are
valuable to us all as humanity to
continue moving towards achieving the
most important
significant battle which is to achieve
peace so that we can defeat poverty once
and for all.
It is in this battle that we all have to
wage to achieve peace. In this context,
we wish to express our unwavering
solidarity with the heroic people of
Cuba. And we also recognize the
principles and values expressed by the
people and government of the People's
Republic of China, in particular the one
China principle, which is
non-negotiable.
We also fully share the struggle against
fascism and the right to peace waged by
the Russian Federation.
Distinguished delegates,
I wish to express to you all in this
forum
the commitment for us all to live
together in a fraternal and
solidarity-based way to achieve dignity
and shared responsibility for all. Thank
you very much.
I thank the foreign minister of
Nicaragua for his address.
